long_description:
Join me and Yukon Goldie, an adorable capybara, for a fun Capybara Yoga class at Possum-bilites in Fredericksburg, VA.

You will have so much fun meeting, petting, and snuggling Yukon Goldie as you enjoy an all-levels Yoga class. She is adorable and her fun, relaxed capybara energy will be so amazing as she visits you on your Yoga mat during the class. It will be an incredible morning with the "world's most relaxed animal". Enjoy lots of photo opportunities with Yukon Goldie and learn all about capybaras from her companion humans and care providers.

The minimum age is 10 and the cost is $35 per person which supports Yukon Goldie's lifelong care, feeding, enrichment, and veterinary services in addition to capybara education.

Space is limited and registration is open now so feel free to contact me to register since this event will fill up quickly. To register, please email me at YW5nZWxhICEgaXJ0Y2kgfCB2ZXJpem9uICEgbmV0.
